title: Bind finite typed runtime parameters to reusable single-section migration presets
description: Users reproduce legacy date/customer/status report requests through the generic preset workspace rather than manually editing saved filters. Stage 2 only. Shared generic reporting capability, not a dedicated business report. Preserve existing legacy routes until full migration acceptance. Recheck current-user menu, row and column scope; no arbitrary SQL/joins, new schema, permission expansion, production or protected files. Preserve concurrent work and truthful environment limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Expose finite parameter metadata and a typed materialization request for existing single-section presets. Bind only declared authorized customer/date/status fields; maintain the original no-parameter API compatibility and immutable template definitions. Validate both endpoints, inverted/out-of-range dates, unknown or unsupported parameters and revoked fields before any draft creation; preserve conjunctive filters.

Reproduce supported legacy start/end and customer/status restrictions for multiple preset families using authoritative existing dataset field semantics, including documented date inclusivity and business timezone. Reject a family whose required original parameter cannot be represented rather than silently omitting it. Persist private drafts through the existing service; no parity-passed based on readiness alone.

Provide generic workspace parameter controls with explicit validation errors, cancellation and existing audit outcomes. Verify at least two families with nonempty isolated SQL rows on date boundaries and current-user scope, no-parameter compatibility, no mutation on invalid input, and Excel/PDF result equivalence for the parameterized definition. Run focused tests and safe Release suite.
implementation_evidence: IReportConfigurationPresetCatalog.MaterializeAsync and ReportConfigurationsController.MaterializePreset accept only preset key/user; unlike ERP-310 bundle presets they expose no typed original legacy request parameters. Backlog/report controller and complete ERP-259..313 history checked; single-section parameter binding is missing.
